user.title: Connect an existing Strava integration
user.description: Select a loaded ha_strava account. Its OAuth session and activity-created event are reused. No second login or webhook subscription is created. For legacy entries, find the numeric athlete ID on your Strava profile.

data.legacy_entry_id: Migrate completed receipts from disabled Activity Tools (optional)

error.source_not_loaded: Load the selected Strava integration first.
error.invalid_athlete: Enter the numeric Strava athlete ID.
error.wrong_athlete: This ID does not match the selected Strava account.
error.legacy_unavailable: Disable the old Activity Tools entry and select the same Strava account.

abort.source_not_loaded: Install and configure ha_strava first. The activity-created event patch is also required.
abort.already_configured: Strava Activity Tools is already configured for this athlete.

get_activity.name: Get activity
get_activity.description: Fetch matching fields for one activity owned by this account.

match_activity.name: Match activity
match_activity.description: Preview title, device, sport, and distance filters without writing.

update_activity.name: Update activity
update_activity.description: Preview or update allowlisted Strava fields, including workout_type compatibility support; preview is the default.

expected.name: Expected preview state (optional)
expected.description: Abort if the sport, workout label, gear or indoor/manual flags changed since the suggestion. Pass the expected object returned by Suggest workout.

append_environment.name: Append historical AQI and UV
append_environment.description: Append historical US EPA AQI and UV worldwide from the run start location, using Open-Meteo/CAMS estimates. HA sensor history is optional. Preview is the default; durable retries preserve notes and source credit.

radius_km.name: Weather coverage radius from home
radius_km.description: Only used with HA sensor history; location API mode has no home-area restriction.

weather_source.name: Weather source
weather_source.description: Location API provides worldwide US EPA AQI and UV without HA sensors or a home zone. Existing calls with sensors retain HA history behavior.

external_fallback.name: Use historical API fallback
external_fallback.description: Send rounded start coordinates and the UTC hour to Open-Meteo. API-derived annotations include source credit; disabled by default.

list_jobs.name: List jobs
list_jobs.description: Inspect this account’s durable jobs, retry times, and safe error categories. No Strava request is made.

replay_job.name: Replay job
replay_job.description: Replay a failed job after fixing its cause. Uses the original account/settings and rechecks remote state before a write.

suggest_workout.name: Suggest workout tag from calendar
suggest_workout.description: Read-only interval matching using the selected training calendar and recorded fast/recovery laps. Returns a reason; never writes a tag.

detect_track.name: Detect likely track run
detect_track.description: Read-only, bounded GPS geometry detection for native automations. A heuristic, not Garmin track-mode metadata. No calendar or shoes required.

init.title: Strava Activity Tools settings
init.description: Choose track shoes from this Strava account. Updating the pair takes effect immediately for previews. Preview only blocks Strava writes; calendar and track-shoe suggestions always remain read-only. {shoe_catalog_status}

data.reauthorize_strava: Request Strava reauthorization (profile and activity editing)

error.shoe_catalog_unavailable: Could not load your Strava shoes. Existing choices are kept; retry when the Strava account is available.
error.invalid_shoes: Choose an active shoe from this Strava account.
